summary.name: Whisk
summary.one_liner: Whisk is a free, open-source clipboard manager for macOS that keeps your copy history in a searchable, keyboard-driven floating panel.
use_cases: Recalling a link or snippet copied earlier
Pasting clipboard items with only the keyboard
Keeping frequently used links or snippets pinned
summary.what_it_does: Whisk runs as a native macOS clipboard manager and shows everything you copy in a floating panel opened with ⇧⌘V from any app. You can search and filter history, navigate cards with arrow keys (and Vim-style keys, per the page), and press Return or click a card to paste. Pins keep important items, and history items can be kept for a day, a month, or forever. It also offers a paste-without-formatting option (⌥⏎) and a playground on the page to try the interface without touching your real clipboard. Installation is via Homebrew cask; the page says the history stays on your Mac.
notable: Free and open source under GPL-3.0, written in Swift
Keyboard-first navigation with arrow keys, Return to paste, and remappable shortcuts
Pins plus per-item retention of a day, a month, or forever
caveats: Available only for macOS according to the page
